content.query: AzureMetrics | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and ResourceId =~ "{apiPlanId}" and MetricName == "CpuPercentage" | summarize cpu = avg(Average) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1m)
content.title: API plan CPU

content.query: AzureMetrics | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and ResourceId =~ "{autoscaleId}" and MetricName in ("ObservedCapacity", "ScaleActionsInitiated") | summarize value = max(Maximum) by MetricName, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
content.title: Autoscale capacity and actions

content.query: union AppRequests, AppDependencies | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and AppRoleName in ("docchat-api", "docchat-ingestion") | summarize instances = dcount(AppRoleInstance) by AppRoleName, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
content.title: Instances per role

content.query: AppMetrics | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name == "docchat.runtime.event_loop_lag" | summarize maxLagMs = max(Max) by AppRoleName, AppRoleInstance, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
content.title: Event-loop lag per instance

content.query: let r = AppRequests | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and AppRoleName == "docchat-api" and Name == "POST /v1/chat/turns" | project st = TimeGenerated, en = TimeGenerated + DurationMs * 1ms; union (r | project t = st, d = 1), (r | project t = en, d = -1) | order by t asc | extend concurrent = row_cumsum(d) | summarize peak = max(concurrent) by bin(t, 5m)
content.title: Peak concurrent chat streams

content.query: AppMetrics | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name == "docchat.sql.duration" | summarize meanMs = sum(Sum) / sum(ItemCount), maxMs = max(Max), calls = sum(ItemCount) by operation = tostring(Properties["operation"]), outcome = tostring(Properties["outcome"]) | order by calls desc
content.title: SQL units of work

content.query: AppMetrics | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name in ("docchat.sql.retries", "docchat.sql.failures", "docchat.sql.pool.in_use", "docchat.sql.idle_releases") | summarize value = sum(Sum) by Name, AppRoleName, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
content.title: SQL retries, failures and pool

content.query: AppMetrics | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name == "docchat.sql.pool.wait" | summarize meanMs = sum(Sum) / sum(ItemCount), maxMs = max(Max) by AppRoleName, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
content.title: SQL pool wait

content.query: AppMetrics | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name == "docchat.conversations.request_charge" | summarize meanRu = sum(Sum) / sum(ItemCount), maxRu = max(Max), n = sum(ItemCount) by operation = tostring(Properties["operation"])
content.title: Cosmos DB request charge per operation

content.query: AppMetrics | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name == "docchat.ingestion.parse.peak_rss" | summarize meanMb = sum(Sum) / sum(ItemCount), maxMb = max(Max) by command = tostring(Properties["parse_command"])
content.title: Parse memory per command
